content.title: Patient Inquiries
content.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions regarding clinical procedures and logistics.

items.question: Are you in-network with my insurance provider?
items.answer: We are in-network with the majority of major PPO plans. Our administrative team will happily perform a complimentary benefits verification prior to your first appointment.

items.question: What is the protocol for an initial patient visit?
items.answer: Your comprehensive first visit includes a detailed exam, low-radiation digital x-rays, periodontal charting, a professional prophylaxis (cleaning), and a customized oral health consultation.

items.question: Do you offer targeted options for patients with dental anxiety?
items.answer: Yes. We maintain a zero-pressure environment and provide targeted amenities such as noise-canceling headphones, weighted blankets, and mild conscious sedation upon request.

items.question: How do you handle acute dental emergencies?
items.answer: We reserve dedicated scheduling blocks daily for urgent care. If you are experiencing severe pain, swelling, or trauma, contact us immediately for priority triage.
